envelope.description: Wire settle at the entries, team.settle and registration

body.title: Wire settle at the entries, team.settle and registration
body.summary: Await settleForAttempt first at the workflow-step start phase, runWorkflowServerSide and the second driver entry, the two build implement entries and resumeStage; add the team.settle daemon operation and the teamSettle terminal command beside park and resume; call registerSignoffHook in the daemon and in makeServices.
acceptanceChecks: Each listed entry awaits settleForAttempt before its gate call and plan, step, synthesize and validate do not
team.settle runs settleSignoff and teamSettle prints what was recorded
Both the daemon and makeServices register the hook

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff-registration.test.ts: both the daemon start and makeServices in the terminal call registerSignoffHook, and each listed daemon entry (workflow-step start, runWorkflowServerSide, the second driver entry, both build implement entries, resumeStage) awaits settleForAttempt before its gate call while plan, step, synthesize and validate do not

src/daemon/__tests__/team-settle.test.ts: the team.settle operation runs settleSignoff for the unit, so a BUILD's completed request is recorded as signed-off and the held Story completes, and teamSettle prints what was recorded or why nothing was
